style: Square 1:1 item icon for VELSTRIA, a premium fantasy mobile MOBA game. AAA game item-icon quality: hand-painted semi-realistic digital painting, crisp detail, rich believable materials (forged metal, gemstones, leather, carved wood, enchanted energy), dramatic rim lighting and strong value contrast so the silhouette reads instantly even when the icon is shown at 40 pixels. Exactly ONE object — the item described below — shown whole (nothing cropped by the frame), large and centered, filling about 75% of the frame. Long items (blades, bows, staves) lie on a diagonal with the grip / handle toward the bottom-left corner and the tip / head toward the top-right corner; talismans and armor are shown front-on in a slight 3/4 view. Armor is displayed empty and freestanding — no wearer, no body, no mannequin, no head or arms — with a broad, flat, gender-neutral chest (no bust shaping, no corseted waist). A talisman's cord or chain stays short and inside the frame. Background: dark, mostly near-black toward the edges, with a softly blurred cosmic nebula tinted {background} concentrated in a soft glow behind the item and a few faint stars, so the brightly lit item clearly stands out from it; no scenery, no characters, no hands, no pedestal. Magical glyph patterns are fine, but absolutely no readable text, letters, numbers, logos, signature, watermark, border, frame or UI elements. Full-bleed square image; keep a thin strip along the bottom edge darker and free of important detail (small tier markers are overlaid there).

tiers.1: Tier 1 (starter item): solid, well-made craftsmanship with simple, mostly unadorned forms and a single modest accent; only a faint touch of magic glow.
tiers.2: Tier 2 (advanced item): refined craftsmanship with engraved details, inlaid gems or precious-metal fittings, and a clearly visible enchantment glow.
tiers.3: Tier 3 (legendary item): a masterwork relic — ornate gilded details, a large glowing core gem or crystal, an intense magical aura with drifting light particles; the most impressive and luxurious version, unmistakably top tier.

Attack.accent: Category accent (attack): blazing crimson-red and ember-orange highlights and glow, sharp aggressive edges, tiny sparks.

Magic.accent: Category accent (magic): luminous violet and amethyst arcane glow, softly floating arcane glyph rings and motes.

Defense.accent: Category accent (defense): cool sapphire and sky-blue protective glow, sturdy reinforced construction, a faint hexagonal barrier shimmer.

Movement.accent: Category accent (movement): bright aquamarine and mint-teal glow, flowing wind or water streaks that suggest speed, feather or fin motifs.

items.name: Malefic Gun
items.concept_ja: 金と青緑の装飾を施した長銃身の魔銃
items.description: An ornate long-barreled arcane musket: a slender barrel of polished gold banded with teal-blue enamel and fine filigree, a flared muzzle trailing a wisp of golden energy, a curved dark-wood stock inlaid with brass, and a glowing amber crystal set into the firing chamber, pulsing with heat.

items.name: Great Dragon Spear
items.concept_ja: 龍の頭から炎の穂先が伸びる長槍
items.description: A long war spear whose head is sculpted as a roaring teal-jade dragon, a leaf-shaped steel blade bursting from its open jaws, a mane of flowing orange flame streaming back along the gilded shaft, red silk tassels below the dragon head and a golden butt-cap.

items.name: Sea Halberd
items.concept_ja: 金の三叉と紫の三日月刃を合わせた海の大槍
items.description: A grand sea halberd: a three-pronged golden trident head fused with a broad sweeping crescent axe-blade of polished white-gold, deep violet sea glass inlaid along the blade, wave-shaped flanges and a spray of glowing droplets, on a dark sea-green shaft wrapped with gold bands.

items.name: Rose Gold Meteor
items.concept_ja: 桃色の隕石を嵌めた薔薇金の剣
items.description: An ornate sword of rose-gold metal with a broad blade engraved with scale-like patterns, a large faceted magenta-pink meteorite gem clasped in golden claws where the blade meets the crossguard, a teal-wrapped grip, and faint pink starlight trailing from the gem.

items.name: Hunter Strike
items.concept_ja: 獲物を追う三日月形の湾曲刃
items.description: A hunter's war-sickle: a long sweeping crescent blade of pale silver-violet steel curving like a new moon, a razor edge and dark gunmetal spine, a short black-leather grip with a bronze ring guard, violet motion streaks following the curve of the blade as if mid-swing.

items.name: Blade of Despair
items.concept_ja: 絶望の瘴気を纏う黒鋼の巨大な大剣
items.description: A huge two-handed greatsword of the darkest black steel, its broad blade jagged near the tip, with bone-white razor edges and a deep crimson rune-etched fuller, a heavy spiked black-iron crossguard shaped like down-swept wings, a long grip wrapped in dark red leather, and a sickly green mist of despair curling off the blade.

items.name: Blade of the Heptaseas
items.concept_ja: 七つの海を渡る海賊の深紅の曲刀
items.description: A pirate's curved cutlass with a wide sweeping blade of crimson-to-magenta tempered steel, a wave pattern rippling along the edge, an ornate golden basket hilt shaped like a curling sea wave set with a small sapphire, and glittering sea foam spraying off the back of the blade.

items.name: Windtalker
items.concept_ja: 風を纏って唸る青鋼の細身の剣
items.description: A slender long sword of blue-silver steel with a gently curved edge, a winged golden crossguard and a dark navy grip, the blade wrapped in a spiraling ribbon of pale wind and white air currents that coil around it like a small cyclone.

items.name: Endless Battle
items.concept_ja: 深紅の翼飾りの鍔を持つ白銀の聖戦の剣
items.description: A crusader's holy war sword with a straight silver-white blade, its hilt set in a large ornate crimson-and-gold winged guard like a battle crest with a glowing red ruby at its center, a red-wrapped grip, and a trail of holy white-gold light running up the edge.

items.name: Berserker's Fury
items.concept_ja: 三日月の大刃を持つ狂戦士の戦斧
items.description: A berserker's war axe with a huge crescent-moon blade of pale moonlit silver, its inner curve dark navy steel engraved with fierce runes, a short thick haft wrapped in dark blue leather, a sharp spike on top, and an icy glint along the crescent edge.

items.name: Haas's Claws
items.concept_ja: 血を啜る三本の湾曲した鉤爪
items.description: A beast-hunter's claw weapon with no wearer: three long curved scythe-like silver claw blades fanning out from a dark crimson-and-black armored knuckle guard, blood-red light running along the edges, a red gem on the back plate and a few drops of crimson glow.

items.name: Malefic Roar
items.concept_ja: 獣の顎を銃口にした金色の手砲
items.description: A heavy brass-and-gold hand cannon with a short wide barrel whose muzzle is cast as a roaring beast's open jaws, dark iron bands and rivets, a curved walnut grip, a spinning ember-orange core visible through a slot in the chamber, and faint smoke curling from the muzzle.

items.name: Winter Crown
items.concept_ja: 氷の結晶でできた冬の王冠
items.description: A crown carved entirely from glowing pale-blue ice crystal: tall jagged icicle spires rising from a frosted silver band, a large sky-blue diamond in the front, frost wings sweeping out on both sides, delicate snowflakes and cold mist drifting around it.

items.name: Fleeting Time
items.ja: フリーティングタイム
items.concept_ja: 時を封じた青い水晶の砂時計
items.description: An hourglass of two glowing sapphire-blue crystal bulbs held in a slender golden frame with swirling clock-hand filigree, shimmering blue sand of light falling through the narrow waist, and small crystal shards floating around it as if time itself is splintering.

items.name: Sky Piercer
items.concept_ja: 天を貫く翠の稲妻の細剣
items.description: A long thin piercing blade like a stiletto-rapier: a narrow needle-straight blade glowing teal-green with crackling lightning, a small golden basket hilt with a swept knuckle bow, and jagged streaks of teal lightning splitting the air around the tip.

items.name: War Axe
items.concept_ja: 赤熱した亀裂が走る黒鉄の大戦斧
items.description: A massive double-bitted battle axe of blackened iron, both broad blades split by glowing molten-orange cracks as if forged in a volcano, a short thick haft wrapped in red leather with golden bands, a spike on top, and sparks and embers bursting from the cracks.

items.name: Wind of Nature
items.concept_ja: 自然の風を宿す翼形の金と翠の弓
items.description: An ornate recurve bow whose golden limbs are shaped like spread leafy wings with teal-green feather plumage at the tips, a glowing emerald set in the grip, an arrow of pale wind nocked on the string, and a soft circular gust of green-white wind swirling around it.

items.name: Golden Staff
items.concept_ja: 伸縮自在の伝説の金の棒
items.description: A legendary extendable fighting staff: a long straight cudgel of gleaming solid gold, its middle wrapped in dark red cloth, both ends capped with thick engraved golden bands bearing cloud-swirl patterns, with faint golden afterimages along its length as if it is spinning.

items.name: Corrosion Scythe
items.concept_ja: 毒の錆に蝕まれた緑の大鎌
items.description: A war scythe with a large curved blade of corroded bronze-green metal, its edge eaten by bubbling acid-green rust, an ornate gold-and-black spiked collar where the blade meets the dark shaft, drips of toxic green ooze and a faint green fume rising from the blade.

items.name: Demon Hunter Sword
items.concept_ja: 魔を狩る紫雷の黒い長剣
items.description: A demon-slayer's long sword with a heavy dark gunmetal blade crackling with violet lightning, a black-iron crossguard with a small golden demon-skull emblem at its center, a grip wrapped in purple leather, and purple sparks arcing between the blade and the guard.

items.name: Magic Blade
items.concept_ja: 青く光る細身の魔力の刃
items.description: A slender, gently curved saber with a translucent glowing sapphire-blue blade, a simple silver guard and a dark blue grip, with thin blue light swirling along the edge.

items.name: Fury Hammer
items.concept_ja: 金の棘を生やした黒鉄の戦槌
items.description: A heavy war mace with a dark iron flanged head studded with sharp golden spikes, a short ash-wood haft bound with leather and bronze rings, and a faint red glow between the flanges.

items.name: Rogue Meteor
items.concept_ja: 隕石のように飛ぶ棘付き鉄球
items.description: A spiked meteor ball of polished silver-grey iron studded with sharp conical spikes all around, a short iron chain hanging from it, with a fiery red streak behind it as if it is hurtling through the air.

items.name: Ogre Tomahawk
items.concept_ja: 鬼が振るう無骨な大斧
items.description: A crude, heavy ogre tomahawk with a wide curved bronze blade, notched and battle-worn, lashed to a thick knotted wooden haft with rough leather straps, a band of red paint across the blade.

items.name: Legion Sword
items.concept_ja: 軍団兵の青鋼の長剣
items.description: A soldier's long sword with a straight broad blade of blue-tinted steel and a central fuller, a golden crossguard with small green gems at its ends, a dark leather grip and a round golden pommel.

items.name: Swift Crossbow
items.concept_ja: 素早く連射できる軽量の弩
items.description: A light repeating crossbow of dark wood and teal-enameled steel with gold-tipped limbs, a bolt magazine mounted on top, a bolt loaded and ready, and a small brass winding crank on the side.

items.name: Regular Spear
items.concept_ja: 兵士の長槍の鋼の穂先
items.description: A plain infantry spear with a long leaf-shaped steel spearhead, a bronze socket wrapped in red cloth, and a straight wooden shaft.

items.name: Expert Gloves
items.ja: エキスパートグローブ
items.concept_ja: 熟練者の青い革の籠手
items.description: A single empty fighter's glove of sturdy navy-blue leather with padded knuckle plates, a red-and-gold striped cuff band at the wrist, standing upright on its own with no hand inside.

items.name: Iron Hunting Bow
items.concept_ja: 鉄で補強した狩猟弓
items.description: A simple hunting bow of dark wood reinforced with iron plates at the grip and tips, green leather wrapped around the handle, and a teal-fletched arrow nocked on the string.

items.name: Vampire Mallet
items.ja: ヴァンパイアハンマー
items.concept_ja: 獣の牙を生やした吸血の槌
items.description: A short vampire-hunter mallet with a dark iron hammer head from which three curved ivory fangs protrude like a beast's teeth, a dark red-wrapped wooden handle, and a faint crimson glint on the fang tips.

items.name: Javelin
items.concept_ja: 投げ槍の鋭い鋼の穂先
items.description: A throwing javelin with a sharp narrow steel point and a pair of small swept-back barbs behind it, a short brass collar, and a slim pale wooden shaft.

items.name: Knife
items.concept_ja: 赤い石を嵌めた湾曲ナイフ
items.description: A small curved knife with a single-edged hooked steel blade, a simple black guard set with one small red stone, and a short dark wooden handle.

items.name: Dagger
items.concept_ja: 素朴な鋼の短剣
items.description: A plain straight dagger with a narrow triangular double-edged steel blade, a short iron crossguard and a dark leather-wrapped grip.

items.name: Power Potion
items.concept_ja: 力が湧き上がる真紅の薬瓶
items.description: A single ornate potion flask of faceted crimson-red glass with a round belly and a short neck, sealed with a dark iron stopper held by a wire cage, filled with a glowing, bubbling red elixir that casts a warm red light.

items.name: Wishing Lantern
items.concept_ja: 蝶の舞う桃色の願いの灯籠
items.description: An ornate hanging lantern with a round body of glowing magenta-pink silk panels in a curved golden frame, a soft pink flame inside, delicate butterfly-wing glass fins on its sides, a short golden hook on top, and a few luminous pink-and-blue butterflies fluttering close around it.

items.name: Flask of the Oasis
items.concept_ja: 命の泉を湛えた蔓草の黄金のフラスコ
items.description: An elegant golden flask with a teardrop body of clear glass holding swirling emerald-green water of life, wrapped in living green vines with fresh leaves sprouting from its neck, a golden star-shaped ornament on the front, and a few glowing water droplets.

items.name: Genius Wand
items.concept_ja: 黄金の炎の爪が抱く青い叡智の宝珠
items.description: A short scepter-wand crowned by a large glowing deep-blue orb of swirling arcane energy, cradled by sweeping golden flame-shaped prongs that curl around it, a slender dark-and-gold handle, and small motes of blue light orbiting the orb.

items.name: Lightning Truncheon
items.concept_ja: 雷を放つ黄金の三叉の短杖
items.description: A short golden truncheon whose head splits into three jagged lightning-bolt prongs holding a crackling blue electric orb between them, the gilded shaft wound with thin silver coils, branching blue lightning arcing off the tips.

items.name: Blood Wings
items.concept_ja: 血と炎でできた片翼
items.description: A single great wing made of blood-red and flame-orange feathers, its long curved pinions glowing like embers at the tips, rooted in an ornate golden clasp set with a dark ruby, wrapped in a soft shield-like aura of crimson light.

items.name: Starlium Scythe
items.concept_ja: 星屑の光を刃にした蒼い大鎌
items.description: A celestial scythe with a long sweeping blade of luminous starlit blue crystal, a golden ring holding a small star where the blade meets the shaft, a dark navy shaft speckled with tiny stars, and a trail of glittering stardust along the edge.

items.name: Glowing Wand
items.concept_ja: 呪いの炎が燃える黒い魔杖
items.description: A dark obsidian wand with a jagged crown-like head cradling a burning magenta-red flame, dark violet fire licking up from it, silver bands around the black shaft, a cursed ember glow and drifting sparks.

items.name: Ice Queen Wand
items.concept_ja: 氷の女王の雪結晶の杖
items.description: An elegant wand of clear blue ice crystal, its tip a long sharp icicle shard with a sparkling snowflake ornament, a silver-white frosted handle with small crystal facets, cold mist and tiny snowflakes drifting from it.

items.name: Concentrated Energy
items.concept_ja: 黒い鉤爪に囚われた濃縮された魔力の渦
items.description: A glowing sphere of tightly compressed violet-blue arcane energy swirling like a tiny vortex, held in a dark iron cage of curved claw-like prongs with gold tips, bright lightning-like tendrils leaking out between the prongs.

items.name: Holy Crystal
items.ja: ガーディアンレリック
items.concept_ja: 聖なる光を放つ緑の聖遺物の水晶
items.description: A large holy relic crystal of radiant emerald green: a tall faceted double-pointed shard floating upright, bound at its middle by an ornate golden reliquary band set with small gems, intense green-white holy light pouring from within.

items.name: Divine Glaive
items.concept_ja: 魔法を断つ紫水晶の聖なる刃
items.description: A divine glaive: a long, elegant blade of translucent violet-blue crystal mounted on a short golden pole, a winged golden guard with a glowing pale-blue gem at its center, and crackling arcane light running along the crystal edge.

items.name: Clock of Destiny
items.concept_ja: 運命を刻む黄金の懐中時計
items.description: An ornate golden pocket watch with its lid open, the dial of deep blue enamel bearing glowing silver hands and small star markings instead of numerals, intricate clockwork gears visible around the rim, a short golden chain, and a faint swirl of blue time energy.

items.name: Feather of Heaven
items.concept_ja: 天上から舞い落ちた光る白金の羽根
items.description: A single large heavenly feather of luminous white and gold, its vanes edged in glowing pale gold, a jeweled golden quill tip set with a small sapphire, and soft golden light motes drifting off it.

items.name: Enchanted Talisman
items.concept_ja: 魔力の目を宿す青と金の護符
items.description: An enchanted talisman: a round gold amulet with a large glowing sapphire-blue gem in the center like an eye, an engraved ring of arcane glyphs and four small pointed golden rays around it, a short braided chain, and blue magic energy spiraling around it.

items.name: Elegant Gem
items.concept_ja: 金の台に嵌めた紫の宝石
items.description: A large oval faceted amethyst-violet gem set in an elegant gold filigree mount with a small loop on top, its inner light glowing softly.

items.name: Exotic Veil
items.concept_ja: 魔力を帯びた異国の薄絹のベール
items.description: An exotic veil of sheer violet and teal silk embroidered with golden arcane patterns, floating gently in the air in soft folds from a small gold clasp at the top, with faint glowing threads.

items.name: Azure Blade
items.concept_ja: 蒼く光る魔剣
items.description: A straight short sword with a glowing azure-blue crystal blade, a golden crossguard shaped like small wings, a dark blue grip, and soft blue light rippling along the blade.

items.name: Tome of Evil
items.concept_ja: 不気味な目の紋を持つ黒い魔導書
items.description: A closed grimoire bound in dark purple leather with blackened iron corner guards and a clasp, a single glowing violet eye-shaped gem on the cover, and purple shadowy smoke seeping from between its pages.

items.name: Magic Wand
items.concept_ja: 青い結晶を戴く魔法の杖
items.description: A slender magic wand of dark blue wood with golden bands, topped by a pointed glowing blue crystal held in small golden prongs, with a gentle sparkle of blue light at the tip.

items.name: Mystic Container
items.ja: ミスティックコンテナー
items.concept_ja: 神秘の魔力を封じた小瓶
items.description: A small mystic container: a rounded glass vessel in an ornate silver cage holding a swirling, glowing violet mist, sealed with a pointed silver cap.

items.name: Book of Sages
items.concept_ja: 橙の紋章を記した賢者の古書
items.description: An old closed book with worn tan leather covers, a simple orange-red circular sigil embossed on the front, brass corners and a cloth bookmark ribbon.

items.name: Magic Necklace
items.concept_ja: 青い雫形の石のペンダント
items.description: A simple necklace with a teardrop-shaped glowing blue stone in a plain silver setting, hanging from a short thin silver chain.

items.name: Power Crystal
items.concept_ja: 魔力を蓄えた青い結晶
items.description: A single raw faceted crystal of clear sapphire blue, pointed at the top, with a faint inner glow of stored mana.

items.name: Mystery Codex
items.concept_ja: 金の紋が入った赤い魔導書
items.description: A small closed spellbook bound in crimson-red leather, a simple gold emblem in the center of the cover, gilt page edges and a short leather strap.

items.name: Magic Potion
items.concept_ja: 魔力を満たす紫紺の薬瓶
items.description: A single ornate potion flask of faceted deep-blue glass with a long slender neck, filled with a glowing, swirling violet-blue elixir, a silver stopper shaped like a small star, tiny bubbles rising inside and a soft blue-violet light.

items.name: Radiant Armor
items.concept_ja: 陽光を放つ黄金の胸甲
items.description: A radiant golden breastplate with broad rounded pauldrons, a sun emblem in the center of the chest holding a glowing amber gem, layered gilded plates engraved with sunrays, and warm golden-orange holy light radiating from its seams.

items.name: Chastise Pauldron
items.concept_ja: 稲妻を纏う金と黒の重肩甲
items.description: A single massive shoulder pauldron of layered black steel plates trimmed with heavy gold, tall upward-curving golden spikes along its ridge, and blue lightning crackling across its surface, shown alone with no wearer.

items.name: Brute Force Breastplate
items.concept_ja: 棘を備えた黒鉄の荒々しい胸当て
items.description: A brutal heavy breastplate of dark battered iron with jagged spikes on the shoulders, thick riveted plates, a fierce horned beast face embossed on the chest with glowing red eyes, and red war-paint streaks.

items.name: Immortality
items.concept_ja: 不死鳥の紋を刻んだ黄金の胸甲
items.description: A golden armored chest piece of the immortal: a gleaming gilded cuirass with a phoenix spreading its wings across the chest in raised relief, a glowing violet soul gem at the phoenix's heart, feather-shaped golden pauldrons, and a rising aura of rebirth light with drifting golden feathers.

items.name: Dominance Ice
items.concept_ja: 冷気を放つ黒金の大盾
items.description: A heavy kite shield with a dark bronze face and thick gold trim, a sharp angular crest at the top, frost and pale-blue ice crystals creeping over its edges, and a large cold teal-green gem in the center radiating a freezing aura.

items.name: Valkyrie's Shield
items.ja: ヴァルキュリアブレス
items.concept_ja: 戦乙女の桃色の結晶を抱く黄金の盾
items.description: A valkyrie's ornate golden shield of pointed teardrop shape with winged golden flanges, a large vertical diamond-shaped magenta-pink crystal set in its center, engraved feathers along the rim, and a soft protective pink-and-blue glow.

items.name: Oracle
items.concept_ja: 神託の目を持つ翡翠と金の守護紋章
items.description: An oracle's ceremonial guard: a rounded jade-green shield-crest with a gold rim, flanked by large curling golden ram-horn ornaments at the top, a small glowing green seer's-eye gem in the center, and soft emerald healing light swirling around it.

items.name: Antique Cuirass
items.concept_ja: 古代の戦士の青銅の胸鎧
items.description: An ancient bronze cuirass of a forgotten empire, its broad chest plate weathered with green patina and engraved with old geometric patterns, a round bronze medallion with a red gem on the chest, and strips of deep crimson cloth hanging below.

items.name: Guardian Helmet
items.concept_ja: 守護者の金と白銀の兜
items.description: A guardian knight's full helmet of gleaming silver and gold with a tall white plume, a T-shaped visor slit with soft green light inside, gilded cheek guards and a crest of golden wings, shown empty.

items.name: Cursed Helmet
items.concept_ja: 呪いの炎を纏う角付きの黒い兜
items.description: A cursed dark iron helmet with two curved horns, a jagged visor glowing with burning orange-red fire from within, cracked plates leaking flames, and a dark aura of smoldering embers swirling around it, shown empty.

items.name: Thunder Belt
items.concept_ja: 雷を宿す金の留め金の分厚い帯
items.description: A thick warrior's belt of dark leather plated with steel, curled into a loop and shown front-on, its large golden buckle shaped like a lightning-bolt emblem with a glowing blue core, crackling blue-white electricity arcing around the buckle.

items.name: Queen's Wings
items.concept_ja: 魔女王の紅黒い悪魔の翼
items.description: A pair of folded demonic wings joined at an ornate golden clasp with a blood-red jewel, the wings of dark crimson-black leathery membrane with sharp bony spines and glowing red veins, wrapped in a faint dark crimson aura.

items.name: Blade Armor
items.concept_ja: 刃を並べた鋼の鎧
items.description: A steel breastplate bristling with rows of short sharp blades along the shoulders and chest like a porcupine of swords, polished silver plates with crimson trim, and a red gem at the center.

items.name: Steel Legplates
items.ja: スチールレッグプレート
items.concept_ja: 鋼の脚甲
items.description: A single steel leg greave covering shin and knee, made of polished overlapping steel plates with a rounded knee cop, leather straps and brass buckles, standing upright on its own.

items.name: Dreadnaught Armor
items.ja: ドレッドノートメイル
items.concept_ja: 重厚な黒鋼の鎧
items.description: A heavy dark-steel plate chest armor with thick layered pauldrons and riveted bands, a simple raised ridge down the chest, and a gunmetal finish with a dull blue sheen.

items.name: Black Ice Shield
items.concept_ja: 黒い氷の丸盾
items.description: A round shield of dark black-blue ice set in a steel rim, its face cracked with glowing pale-blue frost veins, frost rime along the edge and cold mist rising from it.

items.name: Silence Robe
items.concept_ja: 魔法を鎮める紫紺の法衣
items.description: A hooded mage's robe of deep indigo-violet cloth with silver runes embroidered along the hem and cuffs, displayed empty and upright as if on an invisible frame, the hood open and empty, with a soft blue protective shimmer.

items.name: Molten Essence
items.concept_ja: 溶岩の核を宿した灼熱の塊
items.description: A chunk of molten essence: a rough dark volcanic rock cracked open to reveal a seething orange-yellow lava core, small flames and heat shimmer rising from its cracks.

items.name: Ares Belt
items.concept_ja: 戦神の赤い革帯と金の留め金
items.description: A sturdy red leather war belt coiled into a loop, with a large square golden buckle embossed with a simple shield emblem and steel studs along the strap.

items.name: Hero's Ring
items.concept_ja: 勇者の金と黒の指輪
items.description: A single heavy ring of gold with a black enameled band around its middle engraved with a simple pattern, shown at a slight angle with a faint warm glint.

items.name: Healing Necklace
items.ja: ヒーリングネックレス
items.concept_ja: 赤い癒しの石の首飾り
items.description: A simple necklace with a rounded heart-shaped red gemstone pendant in a plain gold setting on a short thin chain, the stone glowing with a soft warm red healing light.

items.name: Magic Resist Cloak
items.concept_ja: 魔法を弾く青い外套
items.description: A plain folded traveler's cloak of deep blue wool with a simple silver clasp at the collar, its edges faintly shimmering with pale blue light.

items.name: Leather Jerkin
items.concept_ja: 素朴な茶色の革鎧
items.description: A simple sleeveless jerkin of brown boiled leather with stitched seams, laces down the front and a few brass rivets.

items.name: Vitality Crystal
items.ja: バイタリティクリスタル
items.concept_ja: 生命力を宿す緑の結晶
items.description: A single chunky hexagonal gemstone of vivid emerald green with clean facets and a gentle inner green glow of life.

items.name: Rock Potion
items.concept_ja: 身を岩のように固める琥珀色の薬瓶
items.description: A single sturdy potion flask with a squat round body of thick amber glass encased in a cage of carved grey stone, filled with a glowing amber-gold elixir, sealed with a heavy stone stopper bound with leather cord.

items.name: Demon Shoes
items.concept_ja: 白銀と青の魔力の長靴
items.description: A single tall armored boot of polished silver plates over deep blue cloth, a small swept-back silver wing at the top of the shaft, a glowing blue mana crystal at the ankle, and a pointed steel toe.

items.name: Rapid Boots
items.concept_ja: 稲妻の翼を持つ金と青の俊足の靴
items.description: A single sleek boot of dark blue leather with golden greaves, a pair of jagged golden lightning-bolt wings rising from the heel, and blue speed streaks trailing behind it.

items.name: Swift Boots
items.concept_ja: 炎を纏う黄金の装甲靴
items.description: A single armored boot of overlapping polished golden plates with a pointed toe and red cloth lining at the top, flickering orange flames licking around the sole as if dashing.

items.name: Arcane Boots
items.concept_ja: 魔力を帯びた紫の魔導師の靴
items.description: A single mage's boot of rich violet leather with a curled-back cuff of dark blue glowing with arcane light, silver buckles, and small swirling blue-violet magic motes rising from it.

items.name: Magic Shoes
items.concept_ja: 先の反った赤と金の魔法の靴
items.description: A single whimsical magic shoe of crimson velvet with a golden cuff, its long pointed toe curling up into a spiral tipped with a small golden ball, golden embroidery and a faint purple sparkle.

items.name: Tough Boots
items.concept_ja: 金の刃飾りを持つ紫の頑丈な靴
items.description: A single sturdy high boot of thick purple leather with a steel-capped toe, a sharp golden fin-shaped guard rising from the shin, reinforced straps and a heavy sole, with a faint green glow of resilience.

items.name: Warrior Boots
items.concept_ja: 戦士の分厚い茶革と青銅の長靴
items.description: A single heavy warrior's boot of thick brown leather with bronze shin plates and buckled straps, a fur-lined top, scuffed from battle, on a sturdy iron-shod sole.

items.name: Boots
items.concept_ja: 素朴な茶革の長靴
items.description: A single plain brown leather boot with a simple fold-over top, worn stitching and a flat sole, with a small wisp of breeze at the heel.
